calls.statement: SELECT sales_line_id, receipt_id, line_no, sale_date, sale_ts_utc, quantity, net_amount, staff_purchase_flag, channel_code, etl_loaded_at FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key = 37 AND product_key = 1702 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06' ORDER BY sale_date, receipt_id, line_no

SELECT sale_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl, sum(quantity) AS units, max(etl_loaded_at) AS maxload FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key = 37 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_period, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days_with_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.store_key = 37 AND f.product_key = 1702 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (SELECT sale_date, sum(net_amount) AS n, sum(quantity) AS u, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS r FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key = 37 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.sale_date, l.n AS lines_net, r.net_sales_before_returns, r.units_sold, l.u, r.receipts, l.r FROM l LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date = l.sale_date AND r.store_id = 131 ORDER BY 1
